configuration.query: deduplicated lowercased whitespace phrases joined with OR
configuration.rerank: same adequate CLI search candidates; missing/tied BM25 scores retain CLI order

limitations: FTS candidates have no answer/evidence policy; top3 source relevance and candidate abstention are proxies, not measured answer citations/statuses.
Reranking preserves candidate membership and CLI adequacy; result precision and candidate abstention cannot improve by construction.
Broad FTS is diagnostic only: no adequacy gate, exact-code override, context filter or project priority.
FTS latency is warm in-process query plus reranking, excluding index construction and CLI/store startup; never a CLI speedup claim.
Only original fixed 40 cases; project-memory, large corpus, native platforms and independent incidents are not evaluated.

cli_search_ask.scope: three repetitions, separate actual search + ask subprocesses, startup/store reads included

in_process_fts_rerank.scope: three repetitions, warm SQLite MATCH/BM25 plus Python candidate reranking; excludes index build, CLI/store startup and answer construction

decision.reason: Offline ranking experiment only; promotion requires a measured gain without case regressions and validated answer/project policies.
